scripts.lint:payment: npm run lint:payment:openapi && npm run lint:payment:asyncapi
scripts.generate:payment: redocly bundle ../http/payment/v1/openapi.yaml --output ../generated/payment-public.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle ../http/payment/internal/v1/openapi.yaml --output ../generated/payment-internal.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle ../events/payment/v2/asyncapi.yaml --output ../generated/payment-events.asyncapi.yaml && redocly bundle ../events/payment/internal/v1/asyncapi.yaml --output ../generated/payment-webhook-internal.asyncapi.yaml
scripts.verify:payment: npm run lint:payment && npm run generate:payment
